brief_intent.critique: The screen fails to deliver the core visual centerpiece of the brief: a 'hero beside a layered level preview with platforms, blocks, coins, enemies, and a distant goal.' The bottom section, labeled 'Live preview,' is cropped so severely that only the top edge of a white shape is visible, making the level preview, hero character, and all gameplay elements (platforms, enemies, coins) completely invisible. brief_intent.suggestion: 1. Immediately fix the 'Live preview' section at the bottom. It must be fully visible and contain a clear, layered side-scrolling level with a hero character, platforms, blocks, coins, at least one enemy, and a distant goal (e.g., a flag or castle). Enlarge the world selector thumbnails to better showcase the different environments and their unique features. 4. Integrate the collectible counters (coins, lives, stars) more prominently into the main visual composition, perhaps as part of the level preview or as larger, more stylized icons. 5. Add more expressive, colorful shapes and a stronger sense of depth to the background and UI elements to better convey the 'joyful original identity'.
